resources.string: Double-tap: controls appear, then lock again after 3 s
Swipe sideways: previous / next. In a sequence, its steps first
To leave a sequence: Next item / Previous item
Tap empty space: hide the controls
Switch apps and Zlip becomes the Mini cover, so the cover stays on.
Your palm can\'t set anything off: the cover stays locked.
Pause, skip or turn off the cover from the notification shade too.
To add it: folded, touch and hold the cover → Edit → \'Zlip cover\'.
To open it every time you fold, turn on \'Open when folded\' on Home.
Picture-in-picture is off for this app, so the Mini cover can\'t open.
These apply once the widget is added or \'Open when folded\' is on.
Previous / Next always go in order; shuffle is for auto-advance only.
